```yaml
name: PR Preview Artifact

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-and-upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up .NET SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '6.0'

    - name: Build website
      run: dotnet build website

    - name: Publish website
      run: dotnet publish website -c Release -o ./publish

    - name: Upload artifact
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
      with:
        name: website-preview
        path: ./publish
        retention-days: 30

  deploy-to-cloudflare:
    needs: build-and-upload
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN && secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Download artifact
      uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v4
      with:
        name: website-preview
        path: ./downloaded-artifact

    - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
      uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
      with:
        apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
        accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        command: 'pages publish ./downloaded-artifact --project-name razorconsole-website --env production'
      env:
        WRANGLER_NO_CONFIRMATIONS: true

    - name: Post comment with deployment URL
      run: |
        echo "::add-comment::Deployment successful! 🎉"
        echo "Preview URL: https://${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_URL }}"
      if: always()
```

  build-and-upload:

        name: website-preview
        path: ./publish
        retention-days: 30

  deploy-to-cloudflare:
    needs: build-and-upload
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN && secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
